events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 326 yards and three touchdowns, Davante Adams and Ty Montgomery emerged as playmakers in the second half and the Green Bay Packers beat the struggling Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers throws 3 TD passes, Packers beat Bears 26-10

events.name: New York Giants at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: The New York Giants capitalized on four interceptions of Case Keenum to defeat the Los Angeles Rams 17-10 Sunday in the first NFL game played at London's home of English rugby.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants' 4 interceptions key in 17-10 win over Rams in London

headlines.description: A.J. Green's one-handed catch in the middle of an end zone scrum highlighted Cincinnati's day full of big plays, and the Bengals pulled away to another lopsided win over their intrastate rival.
headlines.shortLinkText: Green's catch highlights Bengals' 31-17 win over Browns

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw a go-ahead, 18-yard touchdown pass to Anquan Boldin with 16 seconds left to lift the Detroit Lions to a 20-17 win over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions top Redskins 20-17 on Stafford's TD pass to Boldin

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw a 7-yard TD pass to Jack Doyle with 1:55 left to put Indy ahead to stay, and the Colts rallied to beat the Titans for their 10th straight win against their AFC South rival.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck still perfect vs. Titans as Colts pull out 34-26 win

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for two touchdowns in another efficient game, Daniel Sorensen returned an interception for another score and the Kansas City Chiefs held off the mistake-prone New Orleans Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Smith leads Chiefs past mistake-prone Saints, 27-21

headlines.description: Jay Ajayi tied an NFL record by surpassing 200 yards rushing for the second game in a row, helping the Miami Dolphins rally past the Buffalo Bills 28-25 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ajayi rushes for 214 yards to help Miami beat Bills 28-25

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick replaced an injured Geno Smith and led the Jets on three scoring drives, and a rejuvenated defense came up with two rare interceptions in a 24-16 comeback win over the Ravens.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick solid in relief in Jets' 24-16 win over Ravens

headlines.description: Josh Huff returned a kickoff 98 yards for a touchdown, Carson Wentz outplayed Sam Bradford and the Eagles beat Minnesota 21-10 on Sunday, handing the Vikings their first loss of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles beat up Bradford, hand Vikings first loss 21-10

headlines.description: Latavius Murray scored twice in his return from turf toe, and the Oakland Raiders handled listless Jacksonville 33-16 Sunday and gave coach Jack Del Rio a victory against his former team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders beat Jaguars 33-16, get Del Rio win vs former team

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Josh Lambo's 42-yard field goal in overtime gave San Diego its first road win of the year as the Chargers rallied from a 17-point deficit to beat the Atlanta Falcons 33-30 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers beat Falcons 33-30 in OT on Lambo's 42-yard FG

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw three touchdown passes and Jacquizz Rodgers ran for 154 yards to lead the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to a 34-17 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston's 3 TD passes help Bucs beat 49ers 34-17

events.name: New England Patriots at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Tom Brady and LeGarrette Blount were too much for the Pittsburgh Steelers, Ben Roethlisberger or no Ben Roethlisberger.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blount, Patriots pull away from Steelers 27-16

headlines.description: Seattle's Stephen Hauschka and Arizona's Chandler Catanzaro missed short field goals that would have won the game in overtime and the Seahawks and Cardinals settled for a 6-6 tie Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kickers miss short field goals, Seahawks, Cards tie 6-6

headlines.description: The Denver Broncos ruined Brock Osweiler's homecoming Monday night, incessantly hurrying, hitting and harassing their former teammate in a 27-9 win over his Houston Texans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Denver gives Osweiler rude welcome in 27-9 win over Houston
